extracted.name: Spicy chicken couscous
extracted.description: This quick one-pot dish is perfect for a summer supper
ingredient_lines: 2 large sliced skinless boneless chicken breast fillets
instruction_lines: Prepare couscous with reduced salt chicken stock, according to the packet instructions. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the onion for 2-3 mins until softened.
Toss in chicken breast fillets and stir fry for 5-6 mins until tender. Add the blanched almonds and, when golden, stir in the hot curry paste and cook for 1 min more.
Add the couscous along with the apricots and the coriander. Toss until hot then serve with plain yogurt if you like.
